collect.title: Data We Collect
collect.content: We only collect data you provide through the contact form: name, email, company name (optional), and message text.

use.title: How We Use Your Data
use.content: We use your data solely to respond to your inquiries. We do not sell or share your data with third parties for marketing purposes.

cookies.title: Cookies & analytics
cookies.content: We use Google Analytics to measure how many people visit and which pages they read. We ask before any analytics cookie is stored: until you accept, nothing is placed on your device and we receive only aggregate, cookieless measurement. If you accept, it collects the pages you viewed, where you arrived from, your device and browser type, and an approximate city-level location. We do not run advertising tracking, and we do not connect this data to your name or email address. You can decline when asked, change your mind by clearing this site's data in your browser, or block cookies in your browser settings.
